events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for three days of peace, love, and music in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Summer of '69 Vibes
angles.copy: Remembering the original festival of peace and music. What's your favourite iconic performance from Woodstock '69?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee. He would have been 91.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. His music continues to define generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer and songwriter of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her rebellious spirit and incredible voice have shaped rock for decades.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that unmistakable swagger to the music scene.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which era of 007 is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the influential co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! His comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury. He would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world said goodbye to Freddie Mercury. His unparalleled talent and stage presence live on forever.
